description: Every generated contract file, classified. The contracts are specifications: frozen types and signatures the implementing roles compile against. The only code they carry is the reviewed boundary code listed here, which enforces a requirement at the type boundary (a credential that never prints its token; a confirmation that exists only from a read-back equal to what was written); each producer replaces nothing in it and implements everything else. Generated by requirements-compiler v41 from the contracts it generates and analysis/amendment.json (X17).
typecheck: CI builds contracts/ContractCheck.fsproj; each negative control must fail to compile
stateMachines: X05 proves each machine's states and events are exactly the cases of one interface's unions
materialization: the bootstrap writes each contract into its producer's file, byte for byte, from the same text; two builds are identical (offline suite)

implementation.rationale: Reads the workspace out of the private address representation. Boundary code: the representation is private so a role cannot be asserted.
Reads the derived role out of the private address representation. Boundary code: the representation is private so a role cannot be asserted.
The only constructor of a catalog address, which is read-only (Writable.ofAddress refuses it). Boundary code: the type is the requirement.

The only constructor of a working-copy address: the reserved workspaces/demo/causa-app-<run> namespace with a CONTRACT section 3 run id, refusing any workspace a catalog names, so no working copy can be a catalog workspace (independent review H1). Boundary code: the type is the requirement.
The only constructor of the private writable-address representation; it refuses a Catalog, so no catalog investigation can reach a save session. Boundary code: the type is the requirement.
Reads the address back out of the private representation (the path and role a save writes under). Boundary code: without it the private type cannot be used.
The credential type's printed form is fixed to <credential>, so no log, exception or interpolation can show the token. Boundary code: the type is the requirement, not application behavior.
The only constructor of the private credential representation. Boundary code: without it the private type cannot be created at all.

The only way to read the token, as an Authorization header. Boundary code: it is what keeps the token out of every other code path; the negative control ReadCredential.fs proves no other reader compiles.
Read-only accessor of the private confirmation representation. Boundary code: consumers can read a confirmation but never build one.
Read-only accessor of the private confirmation representation (as InvestigationId).
Read-only accessor of the private confirmation representation (as InvestigationId).

The only constructor: a confirmation exists only when the read-back equals what was written (one equality test). Boundary code: it is the type-level form of PERSIST-023; the negative control ForgeConfirmation.fs proves nothing else can create one. The save workflow that calls it is persistence's timed work.

The only constructor of the private fixture label; it prefixes FIXTURE: so no fixture-backed value can be presented as integrated. Boundary code: the private type is the requirement. Allowed only as part of the contract change ODR-V415-IF-VIEW (CF-09 A).
Read-only accessor of the private fixture label. Allowed only as part of the contract change ODR-V415-IF-VIEW (CF-09 A).

Constructor of the private Data Visible representation from a stored read; there is no conversion to Understood, so stored data cannot be shown as the kernel's interpretation. Allowed only as part of the contract change ODR-V415-IF-VIEW (CF-09 A).
Constructor of a fixture Data Visible value; it carries its FixtureLabel. Allowed only as part of the contract change ODR-V415-IF-VIEW (CF-09 A).
Read-only accessor of the private Data Visible representation. Allowed only as part of the contract change ODR-V415-IF-VIEW (CF-09 A).
Reads the fixture label, so a view can show that a value is a fixture. Allowed only as part of the contract change ODR-V415-IF-VIEW (CF-09 A).

Maps the value and keeps its provenance (stored reference or fixture label); without it the private case could not be transformed. Allowed only as part of the contract change ODR-V415-IF-VIEW (CF-09 A).
Constructor of the private Data Understood representation; only an adapter holding a domain projection at a version calls it. Allowed only as part of the contract change ODR-V415-IF-VIEW (CF-09 A).
Constructor of a fixture Data Understood value; it carries its FixtureLabel. Allowed only as part of the contract change ODR-V415-IF-VIEW (CF-09 A).
Read-only accessor of the private Data Understood representation. Allowed only as part of the contract change ODR-V415-IF-VIEW (CF-09 A).
Reads the projection version; a fixture has none. Allowed only as part of the contract change ODR-V415-IF-VIEW (CF-09 A).
Reads the fixture label, so a view can show that a value is a fixture. Allowed only as part of the contract change ODR-V415-IF-VIEW (CF-09 A).
Maps the value and keeps its provenance (version or fixture label). Allowed only as part of the contract change ODR-V415-IF-VIEW (CF-09 A).
The URL pattern the only constructor enforces. Allowed only as part of the contract change ODR-V415-IF-VIEW (CF-09 A).

The only constructor of the private SafeUrl: an absolute http(s) URL, well formed, at most 2000 characters; any other link text is never rendered as a link. Allowed only as part of the contract change ODR-V415-IF-VIEW (CF-09 A).
Read-only accessor of the private SafeUrl. Allowed only as part of the contract change ODR-V415-IF-VIEW (CF-09 A).
